full_judgment: 28. It is inferred from the above decisions that the Government and its functionaries, even the Hon'ble Prime Minister, as the Chief Executive of this country, are bound to follow the established principles of law and act judiciously and with reason even when the law empowers such authority with unfettered discretion. Absence of such reason raises presumption that the decision was not taken legally and thereby citizens right cannot be ignored.
